x: Shields' cup (Youths) were won by Peter Barnard and Roger Keys respectively. Points in these contests are awarded for five events, held at various meetings throughout the summer.
Champs at Morden on February 22nd Roger Keys finished an excellent 9th.
Bobby Nelson fought well to hold off Chris Ryan in the one lap event and Roger Keys turned the tables on John Bicourt with a well judged run in the half mile.
